table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	serviceinvcode = dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode,    
	date = dbo.serviceheader.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.serviceheader.discperc,    
	flatdisc = dbo.serviceheader.flatdisc,    
	misccharges = dbo.serviceheader.misccharges, 
	cashreceived = dbo.serviceheader.cashreceived,
	Patient     = dbo.serviceheader.Remarks,
	price = dbo.servicedetail.price,    
	serviceflatdisc = dbo.servicedetail.serviceflatdisc,    
	servicediscperc = dbo.servicedetail.discperc,    
	salesperson = dbo.salesman.name,	
	servicename = service.name,
	qty = dbo.servicedetail.qty,
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, serviceheader.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, serviceheader.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, serviceheader.date)))), 
	Person = dbo.accounts.name,
	doctorname=dbo.doctors.name,
	doctype=Case dbo.serviceheader.servicecatcode When 12 Then 'Cash' When 11 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End,
	headerno=dbo.serviceheader.headerno,
	regno = (SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = ISNULL(serviceheader.PatientCode, (SELECT PA.PatientCode FROM PatientAdmission PA WHERE PA.AdmissionCode=serviceheader.AdmissionCode))),
	patientname = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = ISNULL(serviceheader.PatientCode, (SELECT PA.PatientCode FROM PatientAdmission PA WHERE PA.AdmissionCode=serviceheader.AdmissionCode))),
	location=(SELECT PL.name FROM PatientLocation PL, PatientAdmission PA WHERE PA.AdmissionCode=ServiceHeader.AdmissionCode AND PA.LocationCode=PL.LocationCode),
	ServiceRowID=ServiceDetail.SrvRowID,
	serviceflattax=dbo.servicedetail.serviceflattax,
	servicegstperc=dbo.servicedetail.servicegstperc,
	serviceinvgstperc=dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvgstperc
FROM
	dbo.serviceheader
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.doctors ON (dbo.serviceheader.doctcode = dbo.doctors.doctcode), 
	dbo.servicedetail
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.salesman ON (dbo.servicedetail.smancode = dbo.salesman.salesmancode),    
	dbo.service, 
	dbo.accounts
WHERE  
	dbo.serviceheader.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate  and
	dbo.serviceheader.custcode IN (:aa_custcode) and  
	dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode = dbo.servicedetail.serviceinvcode and  
	dbo.servicedetail.servicecode = service.servicecode and 
	dbo.serviceheader.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode

objects.name: c_totaldisc
objects.expression: sum(  flatdisc for all Distinct  serviceinvcode  )

objects.name: c_totalmisccharges
objects.expression: sum( misccharges for all Distinct  serviceinvcode  )

objects.name: c_totalcashreceived
objects.expression: Sum ( cashreceived for all  Distinct Serviceinvcode)

objects.name: c_totalamount
objects.expression: Round(sum(  c_amount for all ) + sum(misccharges for all distinct  serviceinvcode ) - sum(flatdisc for all distinct   serviceinvcode ), 0) + sum(  c_tottax  for all )

objects.name: c_itemdiscount
objects.expression: Round ( (serviceflatdisc * qty) +  ( price - serviceflatdisc) * qty *  ( servicediscperc *  .01 ) , 2)

objects.name: c_invtotal
objects.expression:
Round ( ( Sum ( c_amount for group 2)  * ( 1 - ( invdiscperc * 0.01)  ) ) -  flatdisc +  misccharges  , 2 ) + Round(Round(Sum(qty * (price - serviceflatdisc) * (1 - servicediscperc * 0.01) * 0.01 * servicegstPerc for group 2), 2) + Sum(qty * serviceflattax for group 2) +
Round(Sum(qty * (price - ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - servicediscperc * 0.01) * (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) - flatdisc for group 2) * 0.01* serviceinvgstperc, 2), 0)

objects.name: c_invdiscperc
objects.expression: Round ( Sum ( c_amount for group 2 ) * (  invdiscperc * 0.01 ) , 2 )

objects.name: c_tottax
objects.expression:
Round(Round(Sum(qty * (price - serviceflatdisc) * (1 - servicediscperc * 0.01) * 0.01 * servicegstPerc for group 2), 2) + Sum(qty * serviceflattax for group 2) +
Round(Sum(qty * (price - ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - servicediscperc * 0.01) * (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) - flatdisc for group 2) * 0.01* serviceinvgstperc, 2), 0)
